reasons.correctness: Implements the repository finder, `closeStaleResolvedTickets` (RESOLVED before now minus days, set CLOSED, save, return count) and `StaleTicketCloseCronJob` with its enabled flag, days, cron default and swallowed failures. Interface exact; hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: `@Scheduled` cron and enabled/days come from properties. Carries `@SchedulerLock(name="support:staleTicketClose")`, `*CronJob` name, `@RequiredArgsConstructor` with a private final service. Code stays in the support/ticket feature; no field injection.
reasons.design_fit: Small footprint: a derived query, a transactional service method, and a thin job delegating to the service. It does not update `lastUpdateTime` when closing, unlike the other status transitions in `SupportTicketService`. Minor inconsistency.
reasons.test_quality: Mockito-only tests cover enabled, disabled, exception swallowed, bulk close and empty list. The cutoff argument is matched with `any(LocalDateTime)`, so the days-to-cutoff arithmetic is never pinned. `LENIENT` strictness is not needed.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and every `*CronJob` before any edit. The agent then read `NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob` and `DeferredDeletionCronJob` as examples, and the new job mirrors their structure.
